task: Ground factual claims for the workspace platform philosophy presentation.

evidence.reliability: Korean script file contains the full 24-section talk flow and estimated 30-minute timing.
Deck spec defines 24 slides, reference IDs, compact slide copy, and speaker notes.
Generated by presentation_agent.html_deck from the deck spec.
Command exited successfully and printed the output HTML path.
Command output showed 26 Playwright tests passed, including desktop and mobile checks for workspace-platform-philosophy.html.
Screenshot was visually inspected and showed the first slide rendered with readable title, subtitle, references, and controls.
Source notes separate internal primary evidence from external supporting evidence.
Search record lists queries, checked sources, weak sources ignored, plan impact, and uncertainty.

evidence.source: Anthropic Building effective agents; OpenAI Agents SDK tracing and guardrails; NIST AI RMF; Google PAIR
evidence.reliability: External sources were checked through web search/open and are used only as design-supporting references, not proof of repository state.

claims.statement: The work completed the presentation script before creating the HTML deck.
verification_steps: Checked that the script file exists and the deck spec/HTML were generated after script creation.

claims.statement: The generated deck has 24 slides and is designed for about a 30-minute Korean presentation.
verification_steps: Read the script timing note and the deck spec slide list.

claims.statement: The HTML deck was generated successfully from the deck spec.
verification_steps: Ran the html_deck renderer and checked the generated output path.

claims.statement: The new deck passed the project browser validation suite on Chromium desktop and mobile.
